out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed espresso cupboard to have the bottom and walls falling out due to water damage/rot. Observed the prep sink at this location to have openings around it.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities. Take out the water damaged/rotted cupboard/surface.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: Observed that hand soap was not provided at handwashing sink in bakery/ dry storage area.
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands. CDI: CFM placed hand soap at sink.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: Observed cooked chicken sausage (110F), cooked pork sausage (129F) hot holding in steam well below 135F.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. CDI: CFM reheated chicken and pork sausage in oven to 176F placed back in steam well for hot holding. CFM turned steam well up to ensure food items maintain internal temperature of 135F or above.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: Observed sliced tomatoes (44F), precooked diced chicken (51F), sliced swiss cheese (54F), sliced cheddar cheese (54F), sliced roast beef (51F) stored inside of preptop cooler above 41F. Observed milk stored on counter in customer self service area at 44F. Observed unsalted butter (67F) stored on counter on cookline
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CDI: CFM relocated food items to WIC to cool to 41F. CFM will not overstock pans inside preptop cooler over the fill line to better maintain food items 41F or below. CFM will use ice baths at the top part of the preptop cooler to maintain temperature of food 41F or below. CFM will keep milk under refrigeration. CFM will use salted butter instead of unsalted butter.

out_items.name: Consumer advisory provided for raw and undercooked food

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food, Disclosure
violations.observation: The following raw and/or undercooked foods are provided on the menu, menu board, table tent or brochure without proper disclosure: Observed no disclosure statement for fried egg with cooked to order option
violations.corrective_action: The Consumer Advisory shall include a disclosure statement that includes a description of the animal-derived foods as raw/undercooked or identification of the animal-derived foods by asterisking (*) them to a footnote that states that the items are served raw or undercooked, or contain raw or undercooked ingredients. CDI: CFM will add disclosure statement for fried eggs.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Common Name, Working Containers
violations.observation: Working containers of poisonous and toxic materials are not properly labeled with a common name. Observed unlabeled chemical bottle in the front kitchen area.
violations.corrective_action: Label all working containers of poisonous and toxic materials, including cleaners and sanitizers, with a common name to prevent the dangerous misuse of these materials. CDI: CFM labeled chemical bottle.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: Observed multiple unlabeled food storage bottles on cookline (oil, chocolate, syrup, blueberry syrup, powder sugar, etc)
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor. Observed box on food stored directly on floor inside of WIF.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. CDI: CFM relocated box of food to shelf inside of WIF.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items Storage and Handling
violations.observation: Observed plastic forks and knives were found displayed with the lip-contact surface facing upward.
violations.corrective_action: Single-service items and cleaned/sanitized utensils shall be handled, displayed, and dispensed so that contamination of food and lip contact surfaces are prevented. CFM turned plastic forks and knives all in the same directions with the handle facing upward.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: Observed 3 dr preptop cooler with 3 different ambient temperatures inside the cooler above 41F: 54F (top), 44F (right bottom), 41F (bottom left).
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. CDI: CFM instructed to repair preptop cooler to ensure unit maintain ambient temperature 41F or less or will not place TCS food items in unit for cold holding. LA MADELEINE FRENCH BAKERY (Inspection Date: 06/23/2025) Page 3 of 4

violations.title: Counter-Mounted Equipment, Elevated or Sealed
violations.observation: The table-mounted dump sink is not installed in a manner that allows for proper cleaning of the unit or the area around it in front kitchen area.
violations.corrective_action: Counter-mounted equipment that is not easily movable shall be installed to allow cleaning of the equipment and areas underneath and around the equipment by being sealed or elevated on legs. CDI: CFM will seal wall around sink.

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, Durable/Smooth Materials
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surface of the following equipment is not corrosion resistant, nonabsorbent, and/or smooth: Observed exposed wood under shelf in front kitchen area and top of mop sink area. Observed wood board with multiple holes used to stored scoops near 3 compartment sink.
violations.corrective_action: Non-food contact surfaces of equipment that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other foods that require frequent cleaning shall be constructed of a corrosion- resistant, nonabsorbent, and smooth material. CFM instructed to remove exposed wood throughout kitchen area. CFM instructed to replace wood board with smooth and easily cleanable material.

violations.title: Air Gaps/Breaks
violations.observation: An air gap between the water supply outlet and the flood rim level at the sanitizer basin is not observed.
violations.corrective_action: An air gap between the water supply inlet and the flood level rim of the plumbing fixture, equipment, or nonfood equipment shall be at least twice the diameter of the water supply inlet and may not be less than one inch. CDI: CFM will cut pipe for sanitizer basin for air gap.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Carbonator w/o Air Gap
violations.observation: A double check valve with an intermediate vent is not installed upstream from a carbonating device and downstream from any copper fittings in the water supply line. Observed non-approved backflow prevention device on soda dispenser machine in front customer service area.
violations.corrective_action: If not provided with an air gap as specified under 5-202.13, a double check valve with an intermediate vent preceded by a screen of not less than 100 mesh to 25.4 mm (100 mesh to 1 inch) shall be installed upstream from a carbonating device and downstream from any copper in the water supply line. CDI: CFM will replace backflow prevention device on soda dispenser machine with approved dual check valve backflow prevention device.

out_items.name: Garbage and refuse properly disposed, facilities maintained

violations.title: Receptacle with Drains, Drain Plug Required
violations.observation: Observed dumpster has no drain plug.
violations.corrective_action: Drains in receptacles and waste handling units for refuse, recyclables, and returnables shall have drain plugs in place. CDI: CFM will replace drain plug on dumpster.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Mops Allowed to Air Dry
violations.observation: Observed that mops are improperly stored between use. Observed mop not properly drying at the mop sink.
violations.corrective_action: Store mops in a position that allows them to air dry without soiling walls, equipment, or supplies. CDI: CFM hung mop.

violations.title: Chemical Sanitization, Quaternary Ammonium Requirements
violations.observation: When tested, the quaternary ammonium compound-based sanitizing solution was observed to be at a concentration less than what is required for effective sanitization of food-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils. Observed the sanitizing solution in the 3 compartment sink with a concentration of 0ppm total quaternary ammonium compound.
violations.corrective_action: The quaternary ammonium sanitizer used in this facility shall have a minimum concentration of at least 200 ppm OR a concentration between 150-400ppm based on the manufacturer's use directions and using the appropriate test kit. PIC ADDED QUATERNARY AMMONIA TO CORRECT THE CONCENTRATION TO 300 ppm

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: vegetable soup 77F
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. PIC DISCARDED FOOD.
